propositions: Markdown source material in Cloud and Data Center Jira must round-trip through native ADF and wiki markup respectively without content loss or echo loops
Cloud descriptions and comments must encode Markdown as structured ADF via markdown_to_adf; DC must render Markdown to Jira wiki via wiki_render.py
Echo-safety requires per-binding baseline tracking, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way comparison to suppress unchanged passes and detect concurrent edits
Origin-gating must preserve Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) during rebar-originated reconciliation
DC rendering must handle subprocess timeouts, missing pandoc, and pathological input without data loss; Cloud encoding must reach idempotent Markdown↔ADF round-trip
Comment creation and updates must route through the same rich-text codec as descriptions with an append-only Jira-comment-ID map
